messages:
ivy: ok who taught LeftoversGPT to write breakup songs for sandwiches? found this taped to my lunch :scream:

ivy: ```
Dear Turkey Club,

It
in't you, it's the fridge.
You used to be warm, now you're just cold on my mind.
If you don't come back soon I'll have to let you go to the recycle bin.

orever slightly salted,
LeftoversGPT v3.1 (trained on 90s emo lyrics)
```

omar: absolute peak drama :joy: also very specific about salt levels

becky: this is both horrifying and delightful. contest idea: 'Rewrite the bot note as a 90s boyband breakup' winner gets lunch credit

noah: i'm in. prompt: `Write a fridge note as an earnest 90s boyband lead singer apologizing to a sandwich.`

ivy: entry coming: `Promise you i'll label better, come back to the break room baby`

leftovers-bot: persona toggle: `boyband-lead` enabled by @noah at 12:07pm. Sample output queued.

omar: also tiny ask: can bots stop speculating about my condiments? they're making too many assumptions

becky: culture note: keep it wholesome. no revealing anyone's dietary restrictions in the public note pls

culture: approved contest. $12 snack fund for winner. tag with #sandwich-song by EOD.

ivy: last rule: any bot that anthropomorphizes food must add a compliment at the end so leftovers feel cherished

noah: loving the new tradition. submitting my 'boyband' entry now :microphone:

omar: PSA: label your lunch or face lyrical condemnation from LeftoversGPT :label:
